steps.say: Check its voltage rating exceeds your circuit supply.

plan.task: Light an LED from a small battery

steps.say: Keep the battery detached; place the LED legs in separate rows.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

steps.say: Put a 470 ohm resistor in series with the LED; connect the long leg toward battery plus.
steps.show: Show the resistor and LED path.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

steps.say: After checking polarity and the series path, connect the battery using the clip.
steps.show: Show the illuminated LED without moving wires.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

steps.say: Unplug USB before positioning the button across the middle gap.
steps.show: Show the button straddling the center gap.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

steps.say: Wire one switch side to digital pin 2 and the opposite side to GND.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

steps.say: Use INPUT_PULLUP for pin 2 and digitalRead to display button state in the serial monitor; upload after checking wiring.
steps.show: Show the serial readings when pressed and released.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

plan.task: Dim an LED using a knob

steps.say: With USB unplugged, wire potentiometer outer pins to 5V and GND and its middle pin to A0.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

steps.say: Connect the LED long leg toward PWM pin 9 with a 220 ohm resistor in series, and its other leg toward GND.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

steps.say: Use analogRead on A0, scale 0–1023 to 0–255, then analogWrite to pin 9; upload after checking wiring.
steps.show: Show brightness changing with the knob.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

steps.say: Put black in COM and the red probe in the V socket; select DC volts above two volts.
steps.show: Show the probe sockets and dial.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

steps.say: Place red on the plus end and black on the flat minus end.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

steps.say: Read the display: around 1.5 volts is typical for a fresh alkaline cell; 1.2 volts alone needs battery chemistry context.
steps.show: Show the voltage and battery label.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

steps.say: Keep the wire disconnected from everything and select continuity on the meter.
steps.show: Show the loose wire and continuity dial setting.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

steps.say: Place one probe on each end; a beep indicates a conducting path, while OL suggests a break or poor contact.
steps.show: Show both contacts and the meter result.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

steps.say: Put on safety glasses and arrange ventilation with the fan moving fumes away from your face.
steps.show: Show the glasses and fan placement.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

steps.say: Set the stand securely and keep fingers clear of the iron tip.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

steps.say: When finished, switch it off and let it cool in its holder; wash your hands before eating.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

steps.say: Unplug USB, then identify the buzzer plus mark.
steps.show: Show the loose USB and plus marking.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

steps.say: For a buzzer rated within the pin current limit, connect plus to pin 8 and minus to GND.
steps.show: Show the rated part and both connections.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

steps.say: Use digitalWrite on pin 8 for this active buzzer; upload after checking wiring, then alternate HIGH and LOW.
steps.check: Confirm the visible arrangement before continuing.

steps.say: Fold the shorter end sideways into a bow shape at the collar.

steps.say: Unplug the headphones and arrange ventilation; put on safety glasses.
steps.show: Show the disconnected plug, glasses and fume extractor.
steps.check: Check that the headphones are disconnected from every device.
steps.safety: Move solder fumes away from your face.

steps.say: Cut off the broken plug and slide heat-shrink tubing onto the cable.
steps.show: Show the cable end and tubing.
steps.check: Check that enough undamaged cable remains.

steps.say: Strip a short section of insulation from each wire without nicking the conductors.
steps.check: Inspect each conductor for damage and identify its terminal from the connector documentation.
steps.safety: Stop if the wire mapping is uncertain.

steps.say: Tin each exposed wire; don't touch the hot tip, and keep the iron in its stand.
steps.check: Inspect for a thin, even solder coating after cooling.
steps.safety: Don't touch the hot soldering iron tip; keep ventilation running.

steps.say: Solder each wire to its identified plug terminal, returning the iron to its stand between joints.
steps.check: Inspect each cooled joint for solder bridges.
steps.safety: Keep fingers away from the hot tip.

steps.say: Switch off the iron and let the joints cool before inspecting for bridges.
steps.show: Show the cooled joints and switched-off iron in its stand.
steps.check: Look for loose strands or joints touching adjacent terminals.
steps.safety: Do not touch the hot tip while it cools.

steps.say: Cover each joint with heat-shrink and shrink it gently, keeping heat away from the cable insulation.
steps.check: Check that no bare conductors touch and the cable has strain relief.

steps.say: Check for shorts with a meter before reconnecting; stop if the wiring or terminal mapping is uncertain.
steps.show: Show the disconnected plug and meter.
steps.check: Check continuity against the connector documentation before reconnecting.
steps.safety: Keep the headphones disconnected during meter checks.
